brief: Holds a collection of texts and counts their words, scores texts with a bigram language model and ranks the terms of each document by TF-IDF.
detail: Your texts are the corpus: pass one text or a list of texts, each one a document, and nothing is downloaded. The counting itself runs in the Zig engine, built on the first question and kept up to date as documents are added; FreeModel releases it. Words are cut and lowercased by the engine with Unicode rules, so Hebrew, Arabic and emoji count like any other word. Documents are numbered from 1. A stzString or stzText is not needed to build one, and the corpus is the entry object of the corpora shelf of the linguistic domain.
receiver: o1 = new stzCorpus([ "the fox jumps over the dog", "the dog sleeps", "שלום עולם שלום" ])
